newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka army launches new offensive in east.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka army launches new offensive in east.

text.p: Sri Lankan armed forces launched a operation codenamed "Rivi Jaya" against separatist Tamil Tiger rebels in an eastern district early on Tuesday, military officials said.
The operation in eastern Batticaloa district, about 200 km (125) miles from Colombo, involved two brigades, they said.
Military sources in Colombo confirmed the operation's launch, but were unable to give further details.

The east has seen repeated clashes between the Sri Lankan military and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels since government forces recaptured the northern Jaffna peninsula early this year.
The Tigers are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils, most of them Hindus, in the north and the east of the predominantly Buddhist Sinhalese nation.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is much higher.
